hypothesis: Within a fixed 64-request offline window, length sorting reduces padding and may improve throughput compared with consecutive dynamic-padded batches of the same size.
selection: One prespecified batch size and window size. No parameter search; report all outcomes. Quality uses the previously evaluated public STS-B test, not a fresh blind set.
scope: Tokenizer cloning, tokenization, sorting, input allocation, ORT inference, pooling, normalization and order restoration. Excludes model/session loading, file IO, network and online queue waiting.
